metadata.title: Cloud Identity and Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing identity, authentication, and authorization in cloud environments across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS service models.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud-native identity systems, service identities, federated authentication, role-based access control, and cross-account authorization models.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing trusted identity and access control boundaries across cloud service models and providers.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud identity trust assumptions depend on the operational and jurisdictional context of the hosting model.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access targeting cloud user accounts, service identities, or federated credentials.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through misconfigured cloud identities, roles, or trust relationships.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion by manipulating identity policies, role assignments, or audit visibility.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid cloud accounts, including user and service identities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Account manipulation through modification of cloud role bindings or trust policies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access management for cloud identities and administrative roles.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong authentication enforcement for cloud user and service identities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Separation of duties and role partitioning across cloud identity domains.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Identity and Access defines the foundational trust properties required to govern identity and authorization in cloud environments. This pattern addresses cloud-native identity constructs, federation, service identities, and cross-account access, recognizing that identity is the primary security control plane in cloud platforms.

components.title: Cloud Identity Federation
components.description: Supports federated identity and trust relationships between on-premises and cloud identity providers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Federated identity allows centralized governance of cloud access without duplicating credentials.

components.title: Service Identity Governance
components.description: Controls non-human identities such as workloads, services, and automation in cloud environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Service identities are governed to prevent excessive or unintended privileges.

components.title: Cloud Role and Policy Governance
components.description: Governs creation and assignment of roles, permissions, and trust policies in cloud platforms.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud roles and policies are defined and maintained to enforce least privilege and separation of duties.
